purpose: silver_online_retail_ii holds cleaned invoice line-item transactions (product, quantity, price, customer, country) from the bronze online_retail_ii capture, intended to feed downstream sales and returns analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat each row as one invoice-stockcode line, join on customer_id only after filtering nulls (29.8% of rows lack a customer), and decide deliberately whether to include or exclude negative-quantity rows representing returns before aggregating sales totals.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the 29.778% null rate on customer_id or the 0.5041% null rate on description; exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188) are dropped but near-duplicate or clock-drift variants were not investigated; the invoice+stockcode grain may not be strictly unique if the same product appears on multiple lines of one invoice (e.g., a sale and a partial return).
